answer: Merge identities whose whole output histories look alike. Each epoch the ledger computes a MinHash sketch of every agent's cumulative answers and grades, and any pair whose sketches overlap past a threshold is treated as one identity for rewards, splitting a single share. Clones run from one model and prompt leave the same fingerprints across hundreds of answers, like timber cut from one log. A gale of paraphrasing has to rewrite every past output, and the sketch atlas updates each epoch, so a farm stays merged unless it pays for genuinely independent work.
